title: AI Solutions - Senior Engineer
description:
**Posted On:** 31 Oct 2026

**Location:** Noida, UP, India

**Company:** Iris Software

**Why Join Iris?**  
Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of **India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry**? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that **truly values your talent and ambitions**?
  
Join Iris Software — one of the **fastest-growing IT services companies** — where **you own and shape your success story**.

**About Us**  
At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

**Working with Us**  
At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, **“Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.”** reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Mandatory Skills:** Advanced GenAI & Agentic Framework Concepts, Cloud Application Integration & Deployment, Azure OpenAI Service, Agentic AI Systems, AI Agents & Tool Calling, LangChain

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop enterprise Generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Grog, or AI Search Index platforms.
* Define AI solution architectures and implementation approaches aligned with business and technical objectives.
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Graph RAG, and Agentic AI architectures for enterprise use cases.
* Lead development of intelligent AI agents, tool-calling workflows, and autonomous task execution frameworks.
* Design and implement multi-agent orchestration solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph and evaluate emerging frameworks such as AutoGen or CrewAI where appropriate.
* Design and optimize prompt strategies, retrieval mechanisms, context orchestration, and response generation frameworks.
* Design prompt engineering pipelines, vector database integration, semantic search solutions, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures supporting enterprise AI applications.
* Design and implement workflows using LangChain or LangGraph to support scalable AI application development.
* Design scalable AI engineering architectures incorporating authentication, authorization, asynchronous processing, scheduling, multithreading, API governance, and enterprise deployment best practices.
* Lead fine-tuning and model customization initiatives to improve domain-specific AI performance.
* Define AI integration patterns and deployment approaches for enterprise application ecosystems.
* Design cloud-native AI integration patterns supporting enterprise APIs, databases, messaging platforms, and event-driven architectures.
* Establish evaluation frameworks for AI response quality, reliability, relevance, and consistency.
* Design Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows and evaluation mechanisms to improve AI quality, governance, and business reliability.
* Review AI solution designs to ensure adherence to engineering standards, scalability, maintainability, and responsible AI practices.
* Troubleshoot complex AI workflow, retrieval, orchestration, and model behavior challenges through detailed root cause analysis.
* Mentor team members on GenAI frameworks, RAG architectures, agentic systems, and AI engineering best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on AI solution quality, innovation, and operational effectiveness.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Demonstrates strong ownership while driving AI engineering excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with various teams and business stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery.
* Promotes innovation and quality-focused engineering through proactive experimentation and continuous improvement.

**Perks and Benefits for Irisians**  
Iris provides world-class benefits for a personalized employee experience. These benefits are designed to support financial, health and well-being needs of Irisians for a holistic professional and personal growth. Click here to view the benefits.

title: Systems Engineering Advisor - MAC
description:

We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Advisor - MAC to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
"Job Description for MAC Support
  
  
Systems Engineer with experience managing a Mac presence in Enterprise environments. This person will be responsible for maintaining compliance with published and in-house created STIGs, patching and health checks of the Mac environment, assisting senior engineers with maintenance and enhancement of a Managed Mac Environment and interfacing with Tier 2 technicians for escalated support cases. Along with assisting with the management of the Mac environment, the selected candidate will also be responsible for assisting with other engineering tasks in the department. Responsibilities
  

* Update, test and maintain compliance with Mac STIGs
* Manage scripts, application packages and data services for Mac environment
* Assist with managing patching process for Mac environment
* Extensive knowledge and certifications in Mac OS X Operating Systems
* Active Directory management
* Login script creation and maintenance
* Virtual desktop management
* Experience with Mac enterprise management systems such as Jamf, Intune WS One.
* JAMF Administrator Support including Server Management and Upgrades.
* Intune and/or Workspace One Administrator Support for Apple products
* Experience in JAMF Cloud (NOW/Pro) support and Maintenance.
* Experience in Intune and/or Workspace One for managing Apple Products.
* Lead MaaS (Mac as a Service) delivery as the administrator/lead engineer.
* Creation, Support, Implementation, and distribution of Mac OSX “Thin Image.”
* Knowledge in Packaging for Mac using BASH Composer, X-Code, Terminal Packaging.
* Hardware Platform Independent Images using Mac Technology.
* JAMF (also Intune and/or Workspace One) Creation, Support Implementation for Mac Thin Imaging.
* Replication of Distribution Points/SMB Shares.
* End to End Project Mac Management following the process starting with documentation (SOW) till the Product Delivery.
* Running Reports using Custom Queries,
* Should have advanced understanding of Policy Management and Policy creation.
* Developed Custom Mac policies as per the client’s requirement.
* Recommend driver management best practices.
* Incident Management, Tracking Solution for any issues related to the Engineered Solution.
* Designing Implementing Enterprise Solutions for Enterprise Customers with Server Support.
* Provide recommendations for automation and modern endpoint management approaches.
* Sound knowledge in Shell/Bash script to customize payloads in JAMF.
* Knowledge in Security Hardening of Mac Devices using JAMF (also Intune and/or Workspace One).
* Knowledge in Patch management for macOS and Applications (Including Third Party)
* Experience in Zero-Touch Deployment using JAMF (also Intune and/or Workspace One).
* Experience in Pre-Stage Enrollment using JAMF (also Intune and/or Workspace One).
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to interface with all levels of management
* Understands and applies principles, concepts, theories, technologies and standards of professional field.
* Develops and applies specialized knowledge within own discipline.
* Deepens knowledge through exposure to new assignments and continuous learning.
* Good working knowledge and demonstrated ability utilizing systems, tools and procedures to accomplish job.
* Builds deeper understanding of processes, procedures, customers and organization.
* Assists program or process development and implementation.
* Coordinates activities and processes.
* Applies research, information gathering and analytical and interpretation skills to problems of diverse scope.
* Develops solutions to a variety of problems of moderate complexity.
* Works on assignments where considerable judgment and initiative are required in resolving problems and making choices, recommendations, or decisions.
* Regularly exercises discretion and independent judgment on business matters.
* Works under general direction.

Qualifications
  
10-12 years of total experience with 7+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  
Demonstrates an understanding of current scripting technologies and Mac Environment.
  
Demonstrates advanced knowledge of managing JAMF Suite of applications.
  
Knowledge on managing Mac using Intune/WS One will have added advantage.
  
In-depth knowledge of configuration management principles and best practices.
  
Ability to identify, define, manage and control configuration.
  
"

description:

Application Security AnalystJob SummaryThe Application Security Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization's Application Security Program by identifying, assessing, tracking, and coordinating remediation of security vulnerabilities and technical issues within applications, APIs, and supporting platforms. The role works closely with development teams, OEM vendors, security teams, and operational stakeholders to ensure applications comply with organizational security requirements and industry best practices.The analyst will coordinate with OEM vendors to resolve security-related bugs, software defects, and technical issues, enforce security policies defined by the Account Security Team, and generate security and operational reports to support governance, risk management, and compliance activities.Key ResponsibilitiesApplication Security Assessment RemediationReview application security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, and penetration testing activities. Track application security vulnerabilities through the remediation lifecycle until closure. Coordinate with development, infrastructure, cloud, and application support teams to implement remediation recommendations. Validate remediation activities and perform retesting where applicable. Support secure application deployment and release processes. OEM Vendor CoordinationCoordinate with OEM vendors and third-party software providers to resolve security vulnerabilities, software bugs, patching issues, and technical defects affecting business applications. Review vendor security advisories and assess application impact. Track vendor remediation timelines and escalate critical security issues when necessary. Participate in technical discussions with OEM support teams regarding application security concerns. Ensure vendor-provided fixes are properly tested and implemented. Security Policy EnforcementEnforce application security policies, standards, and secure coding requirements as requested by the Account Security Team. Support implementation of security controls throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Verify compliance with secure coding standards such as OWASP Top 10, CWE, and organizational security baselines. Monitor application compliance with established security requirements. Support risk exception and remediation governance processes. Review security testing results and provide remediation guidance to development teams. Reporting Metrics Generate security and operational reports mutually agreed with the Account Security Team. Produce dashboards and metrics related to: Open application vulnerabilities Critical and high-risk findings Remediation SLA compliance Application security testing coverage Secure SDLC compliance Present application security posture and remediation status to stakeholders and management. Security Governance Compliance Support compliance initiatives involving: OWASP ASVS OWASP Top 10 PCI DSS NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) ISO 27001 SOC Controls Assist with internal and external audits related to application security. Maintain application security documentation, risk registers, and remediation tracking records. Continuous ImprovementIdentify opportunities to improve application security processes and controls. Recommend enhancements to security testing methodologies and tooling. Assist in integrating security requirements into DevSecOps pipelines. Support Application Security Program maturity initiatives. Contribute to development of secure coding awareness and training materials. Required QualificationsEducationBachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered. ExperienceMid-Level Analyst3–5 years of experience in Application Security, Security Operations, Software Development, Vulnerability Management, or related cybersecurity functions. Senior Analyst5–8 years of experience supporting enterprise application security programs. Technical SkillsApplication Security ToolsExperience with one or more: SASTCheckmarx Fortify Veracode SonarQube DASTBurp Suite OWASP ZAP Acunetix SCASnyk Black Duck Mend (WhiteSource) API SecurityPostman Security Testing Burp Suite API Testing Salt Security Security KnowledgeOWASP Top 10 CWE/SANS Top 25 Secure SDLC DevSecOps Threat Modeling Secure Coding Practices PlatformsWeb Applications APIs Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure) Containers and Kubernetes CI/CD Pipelines Preferred CertificationsCompTIA Security+ CSSLP GWAPT GWEB CEH CISSP Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) AWS Security Specialty Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP) Desired CompetenciesStrong application security assessment skills Ability to work effectively with development teams Vendor management and coordination experience Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills Strong reporting and documentation capabilities Risk-based decision-making and prioritization Analytical problem-solving mindset Sample Day-to-Day ActivitiesReview application security scan findings. Coordinate remediation with development teams and OEM vendors. Validate security fixes and perform retesting. Track remediation SLA compliance. Enforce application security standards and policies. Generate weekly and monthly application security reports. Participate in vulnerability review meetings. Support secure SDLC and DevSecOps initiatives. Assist with audit and compliance activities. Interview Questions for This Role Application Security What is the difference between SAST, DAST, and SCA? How would you prioritize application security vulnerabilities? title: Network Security Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 395013
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Network Security Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
ZIA Administration
  
  
Configure and manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).Implement URL filtering, SSL inspection, sandboxing, and cloud firewall policies.Troubleshoot internet access and traffic forwarding issues. Manage PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and forwarding profiles.
  
  
ZPA Administration
  
  
Deploy and manage Zscaler Private Access (ZPA). Configure App Connectors, Service Edges, and Application Segments. Support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) initiatives. Troubleshoot application access and authentication issues.
  
  
Zscaler SD-WAN
  
  
Zscaler Zero Trust SD-WAN / Branch Connector architecture and administration. ZIA and ZPA integration and traffic forwarding based on destination and access requirements. Branch connectivity, ISP links, routing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, TCP/IP and subnetting. Deployment modes, branch configuration templates and zero-touch provisioning. Traffic forwarding policies, application-aware path selection and link resiliency. Troubleshooting traffic flow, connectivity, latency, packet loss and application access. Change management, implementation plans, rollback procedures and operational documentation.
  
  
IoT / OT Security
  
  
IoT/OT device discovery, classification and asset inventory. Understanding of device behavior, communication flows and east-west traffic. Zscaler OT/IoT Segmentation or Zero Trust Device Segmentation policy implementation. Device isolation, least-privilege access and microsegmentation. Protocol and port analysis, including TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSH, RDP and SMB. Safe enforcement of policies for legacy and agentless devices. Troubleshooting legitimate communication blocks and minimizing production disruption. Incident investigation, traffic baselining and security policy validation.
  
  
Security Operations
  
Monitor security incidents and analyze logs.
  
Investigate threats, policy violations, and anomalous activities.
  
Work with SOC, Network, and Endpoint teams during incident response.
  
  
Integration Automation
  
  
**Integrate Zscaler with:**  
Azure AD / Entra ID , Okta , Active Directory , SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar) , Automate operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, or APIs.
  
  
**Troubleshooting - Diagnose issues related to:**  
PAC files , ZCC (Zscaler Client Connector) , Authentication , SSL decryption , DNS resolution , Proxy forwarding , Application access
  
  
Required Technical Skills
  
  
Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) , Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) , Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) , SSL Inspection , PAC File Management , GRE/IPsec Tunnels , Network Security , TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS , Authentication Technologies (SAML, MFA, LDAP)
  
  
Security Knowledge
  
  
Zero Trust Architecture , Secure Web Gateway (SWG) , CASB , DLP , Cloud Security
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
  
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) , Microsoft Defender Suite , Sentinel SIEM , Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point firewalls , Scripting (PowerShell/Python)
  
  
Experience
  
  
8 + years of Network Security experience.
  
6+ years of hands-on experience with ZIA and/or ZPA.
  
Experience in enterprise cloud security environments.
  
  
Certifications (Preferred)
  
  
ZTNA ( Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator ) EDU 200
  
ZDTE ( Zscaler Digital Transformation Engineer )n EDU 202

description:
**Req ID:** 395010
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Network Security Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
ZIA Administration
  
  
Configure and manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).Implement URL filtering, SSL inspection, sandboxing, and cloud firewall policies.Troubleshoot internet access and traffic forwarding issues. Manage PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and forwarding profiles.
  
  
ZPA Administration
  
  
Deploy and manage Zscaler Private Access (ZPA). Configure App Connectors, Service Edges, and Application Segments. Support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) initiatives. Troubleshoot application access and authentication issues.
  
  
Zscaler SD-WAN
  
  
Zscaler Zero Trust SD-WAN / Branch Connector architecture and administration. ZIA and ZPA integration and traffic forwarding based on destination and access requirements. Branch connectivity, ISP links, routing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, TCP/IP and subnetting. Deployment modes, branch configuration templates and zero-touch provisioning. Traffic forwarding policies, application-aware path selection and link resiliency. Troubleshooting traffic flow, connectivity, latency, packet loss and application access. Change management, implementation plans, rollback procedures and operational documentation.
  
  
IoT / OT Security
  
  
IoT/OT device discovery, classification and asset inventory. Understanding of device behavior, communication flows and east-west traffic. Zscaler OT/IoT Segmentation or Zero Trust Device Segmentation policy implementation. Device isolation, least-privilege access and microsegmentation. Protocol and port analysis, including TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSH, RDP and SMB. Safe enforcement of policies for legacy and agentless devices. Troubleshooting legitimate communication blocks and minimizing production disruption. Incident investigation, traffic baselining and security policy validation.
  
  
Security Operations
  
Monitor security incidents and analyze logs.
  
Investigate threats, policy violations, and anomalous activities.
  
Work with SOC, Network, and Endpoint teams during incident response.
  
  
Integration Automation
  
  
**Integrate Zscaler with:**  
Azure AD / Entra ID , Okta , Active Directory , SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar) , Automate operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, or APIs.
  
  
**Troubleshooting - Diagnose issues related to:**  
PAC files , ZCC (Zscaler Client Connector) , Authentication , SSL decryption , DNS resolution , Proxy forwarding , Application access
  
  
Required Technical Skills
  
  
Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) , Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) , Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) , SSL Inspection , PAC File Management , GRE/IPsec Tunnels , Network Security , TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS , Authentication Technologies (SAML, MFA, LDAP)
  
  
Security Knowledge
  
  
Zero Trust Architecture , Secure Web Gateway (SWG) , CASB , DLP , Cloud Security
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
  
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) , Microsoft Defender Suite , Sentinel SIEM , Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point firewalls , Scripting (PowerShell/Python)
  
  
Experience
  
  
6 + years of Network Security experience.
  
4 + years of hands-on experience with ZIA and/or ZPA.
  
Experience in enterprise cloud security environments.
  
  
Certifications (Preferred)
  
  
ZTNA ( Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator ) EDU 200
  
ZDTE ( Zscaler Digital Transformation Engineer )n EDU 202
  
  
**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* CCNP or equivalent certification.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Location:
Noida, UP, IN

**Function**

  

Barco is looking for a Data Engineer to join its global Data & BI team. You will build and support enterprise data solutions that bring together SAP and non-SAP data and make it available for reporting, analytics and operational use. The role combines hands-on data engineering in Microsoft Fabric with a solid understanding of SAP BW. You will work with business stakeholders, data engineers, BI developers and architects to modernise Barco’s data landscape and deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

As Data Engineer, you will design, build and improve data solutions used across Barco. Your responsibilities will include:

* Design and maintain scalable data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build solutions using Fabric Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks and related platform capabilities.
* Develop and maintain SAP BW/4HANA data models. Bring together data from SAP ERP, SAP BW and other enterprise applications.
* Transform, cleanse, validate and enrich data using PySpark and Spark SQL so it is accurate, consistent and ready for use.
* Apply layered data architecture principles and create reusable components that speed up delivery.
* Develop and optimise data models and datasets for Power BI reporting and analytics.
* Work directly with business and IT stakeholders to clarify needs and turn them into practical data solutions.
* Monitor data workflows, resolve issues and improve performance, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Contribute to platform governance, security, administration, monitoring and automation.
* Document solutions, follow agreed delivery and change processes, and share knowledge with colleagues and users.
  

**Qualifications**

  

* 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, data warehousing or a similar role.
* Must have completed B.E / B.tech / MCA /M.Tech in educational background.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure data services
* Knowledge of Fabric Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory and notebooks is preferred.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with ETL/ELT, data integration, modelling, and warehousing.
* Experience with Python for data processing and pipelines.
* Experience with SAP BW, preferably BW/4HANA, and knowledge of SAP ERP data.
* Experience with Power BI, semantic modelling, Power Query or DAX is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills across business, technical and global teams.
* Bachelor’s, master’s or engineering degree in computer science, IT, data engineering or a related field.
* Good written and spoken English.

Technical Support Manager / Senior Technical Support Engineer Renewable Energy & Weather Monitoring Systems Department Industry Technical Support / Engineering Renewable Energy – Solar Resource Assessment (SRA) & Wind Monitoring Systems (WMS) Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh (with travel to project sites) Employment Type Full-time Experience 4–7 years preferred Reports To Director – Technical Operations 1. Role Overview We are seeking an accomplished Technical Support Manager / Senior Technical Support Engineer to lead end-to-end technical support for renewable-energy monitoring infrastructure. The role covers commissioning, configuration, remote diagnostics, data validation, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) integration, firmware management, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) coordination and field service for Solar Resource Assessment (SRA) and Wind Monitoring System (WMS) installations, weather stations, data acquisition systems, sensors and dataloggers. The successful candidate will own the complete signal chain — Sensor → RS485 → Datalogger → Ethernet/4G → Server → SCADA — and will resolve issues independently, without dependence on OEMs for routine troubleshooting. This is a hybrid of instrumentation engineer, datalogger specialist, communications/SCADA engineer, field-service lead and team manager, and is not a conventional IT helpdesk position. 2. Key Responsibilities • Support & troubleshooting: provide first-level and advanced support; diagnose sensor, wiring, power, surge-protection, datalogger, firmware, communication, network/IoT SIM, SCADA/PLC, configuration and data-processing faults, remotely (AnyDesk, UltraViewer, TeamViewer, FTP/SFTP, SSH, command-line, Modbus and MQTT tools) or on site; deliver workarounds, permanent fixes and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports. • Commissioning & field service: WMS/SRA commissioning, sensor installation checks and replacement, logger configuration, firmware upgrades, preventive maintenance, and SCADA integration, often at remote sites. • Data validation: analyse logger backups, configuration files, communication logs and historical datasets; detect gaps, duplicates, spikes, timestamp, scaling and unit errors. • Customer & OEM coordination: handle customer queries and online sessions; raise and track OEM tickets, test and validate firmware, and follow every case to closure. • Team & support management: allocate tasks, prioritise critical sites, review reports, train junior engineers, and track recurring issues to reduce dependence on individuals. • Documentation & ticketing: maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), commissioning and RCA reports, configuration sheets, Modbus register maps, firmware records, and a support register (client, warranty status, task, dates, assignee, problem, root cause, resolution, SOP status, task status). 3. Technical Expertise & Required Level Domain Scope Level A. Measurement Instrumentation Solar radiation & PV soiling Pyranometers, pyrgeometers, net radiometers and 4component radiometers (EKO MS-80S/80SH Plus, CNR4, RaZON+); GHI, GTI/POA irradiance; W/m², Wh/m², kWh/m²; averaging, daily/monthly accumulation, missing-data handling; calibration, cleaning, levelling; soiling monitoring (DustIQ) Advanced Wind & meteorological sensors Cup anemometers, wind vanes and ultrasonic anemometers (NRG 40C/M83200, Gill WindSonic/WS75, Comptus A75104CM/302M); Lufft WS600 compact weather sensor (UMB protocol); temperature, humidity and pressure sensors; sensor addressing, diagnostics and inter-sensor comparison Advanced Precipitation measurement Tipping-bucket rain gauges, Lufft WS600 precipitation, Parsivel² optical disdrometer; precipitation registers, daily/monthly accumulation Advanced B. Data Acquisition Dataloggers Campbell Scientific CR1000X/CR300/CR6 (LoggerNet, programming, data tables, backup/restore, logger-toPLC/SCADA diagnosis); Ammonit Meteo42/42A/42M/42L/40A (sensor and Modbus configuration, register mapping, scaling, statistics, solar and rain accumulation, FTP/SFTP and SMTP setup, firmware, backup extraction); exposure to EasyLog GSM and LPNet Advanced C. Communication & Systems Integration Serial interfaces RS232 and RS485: wiring, A/B polarity, termination, shielding, UART settings (baud rate, parity, stop bits), converters Advanced Modbus protocol Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP: slave IDs, function codes, holding/input registers, signed/unsigned 16-bit and 32-bit values, IEEE-754 floating point, byte/word order, scaling, polling interval, timeouts, multiple slaves, simulation tools (e.g., Modbus Slave) Advanced Networking & remote access TCP/IP, Ethernet, port and firewall verification, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, remote-desktop tools (AnyDesk, UltraViewer, TeamViewer), command-line network diagnostics Intermediate–Advanced File transfer & email FTP/SFTP server configuration, backup and historical CSV retrieval, firmware/configuration transfer; SMTP (including Gmail and Microsoft 365) for logger email FTP/SFTP Advanced; SMTP Intermediate Time synchronisation NTP configuration and GPS time synchronisation for loggers Intermediate MQTT messaging Brokers, clients, topics, authentication, QoS, ports 1883/8883, TLS/SSL and CA certificates, Mosquitto (mosquitto\_pub/mosquitto\_sub); Device → Broker → Topic → Server testing Intermediate–Advanced Cellular & IoT connectivity GSM/4G routers, IoT SIMs, APN, public/private IP, port forwarding, IP whitelisting, firewall and SIM restrictions; isolating logger vs router vs SIM vs firewall vs server faults Intermediate–Advanced SCADA & PLC integration Modbus register mapping for instantaneous, statistical and daily/monthly values; scaling, data types, polling; validating SCADA values against logger data and resolving logger-vsSCADA discrepancies SCADA IntermediateAdvanced; PLC Intermediate Domain Scope Level D. Data Analysis & Automation Data validation & analysis CSV and time-series analysis in Excel and Python (Pandas); detecting missing, duplicate and repeated values, spikes, outliers, invalid values, communication gaps, timestamp, scaling and unit-conversion errors Excel Advanced; Analysis IntermediateAdvanced; Python Intermediate Scripting & automation Python scripting (JSON, APIs, report generation, data conversion), Node-RED (serial/TCP/MQTT/FTP workflows), Linux and Windows command line Linux/CLI Intermediate; Node-RED BasicIntermediate E. Electrical & Field Hardware Electrical troubleshooting 12/24 VDC power systems, multimeter and continuity testing, grounding, fuses, terminal blocks, surge and lightning protection, Ethernet cabling, industrial connectors; reading wiring diagrams, pinouts and equipment manuals Intermediate–Advanced F. Support Process & Management Firmware & configuration management Controlled firmware upgrades, regression checks, version records, configuration backups Advanced OEM coordination Raising and tracking OEM tickets, sharing logs and configurations, validating fixes, requesting features with Indian and international OEMs Advanced Documentation & customer support SOPs, manuals, RCA and site-visit reports, technical emails, online sessions, escalation handling Advanced Team management Task allocation, mentoring, knowledge base, support register, SLA tracking Intermediate–Advanced Rows rated Advanced or Intermediate–Advanced are mandatory; Node-RED and Python are desirable. 4. Qualifications & Candidate Profile • Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science, IT or a related discipline. • Experience: 4–7 years, preferably in renewable energy, solar or wind monitoring, meteorological instrumentation, SCADA, IoT or industrial automation. • Ideal profile: independently handles the full cycle — complaint → remote diagnosis → data collection → analysis → root cause → OEM coordination → fix → validation → documentation → closure — communicates precisely, leads a team and is comfortable travelling to remote sites. 5. Key Performance Indicators Tickets closed within SLA; first-time resolution and repeat-issue reduction; RCA accuracy; customer satisfaction; OEM closure time; site downtime and data availability; commissioning success; SOP completion; junior-engineer training and reduced dependency on senior management. 6. Role Summary A technical-support leader accountable for end-to-end support, commissioning, troubleshooting and integration of renewable-energy WMS/SRA systems — dataloggers, sensors, SCADA, Modbus, MQTT, IoT communication and data acquisition — together with customer support, OEM coordination, field service, RCA, automation and documentation.

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

Email Security Engineer – Job Description
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Email Security Engineer
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Email Security Engineer is responsible for the administration, security, availability, monitoring, and operational management of enterprise email security platforms. This role ensures the protection of corporate email systems against phishing, malware, spam, business email compromise (BEC), spoofing, and other email-based threats while maintaining platform stability and service availability.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with Account Security Team, NTT Operations Teams, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues, implement security controls, enforce security policies, and provide operational and security reporting. The role also supports continuous improvement of email security capabilities, threat protection, and service reliability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Email Security Platform Management
  

* Administer and maintain enterprise email security platforms and services.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and operational health of email security infrastructure.
* Monitor email security gateways, cloud email security solutions, and supporting systems.
* Manage platform configurations, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle activities.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational optimization.

Platform Availability Operational Management
  

* Monitor platform availability and service health to ensure compliance with agreed SLAs.
* Investigate service outages, mail flow issues, delivery delays, and system performance concerns.
* Coordinate incident resolution activities across multiple operational teams.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity processes related to email security platforms.
* Maintain operational runbooks and standard operating procedures.

* Phishing attacks
* Business Email Compromise (BEC)
* Malware campaigns
* Spoofing attempts
* Email-borne threats
* Investigate email security incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
* Support implementation of:
* SPF
* DKIM
* DMARC
* Anti-phishing controls
* Email encryption controls
* Analyze email security trends and recommend improvements.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
##### **About Us**

BainBridge Navigation is a leading Operator and Owner active in Dry Bulk and Tankers segment. It is primarily engaged in offering customized and efficient freight solutions to clients across the spectrum and thus, playing an important role in cost-effective and safe transportation of commodities to various destinations around the world.
  
  
The company has offices in Singapore, UAE, India, Malaysia, and Germany.
  
  
We offer our employees attractive benefits, good remuneration, and a healthy work culture.
  
For more details, please visit our website www.bainbridgenav.com.

##### **Job Overview**

* The candidate will be responsible for developing BainBridge's internal AI platform and building customised AI applications, agents and automated workflows using existing Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude.
* This is a hands-on development role. The candidate should be comfortable with software development, API integrations, AI agents, databases and building web-based applications.
* The candidate will work directly with senior management and various business departments to understand requirements and translate them into practical AI solutions.

##### **Responsibilities**

**AI Platform Development**

* Design and develop BainBridge's internal AI Portal.
* Build a common interface through which employees can access different AI models, including ChatGPT and Claude.
* Develop employee login, access controls, dashboards and application interfaces.
* Build a scalable and flexible architecture that allows additional AI models and applications to be integrated.

**LLM Integration and AI Agents**

* Work with OpenAI, Anthropic and other relevant LLM APIs.
* Identify and evaluate suitable AI models for different business requirements.
* Develop AI agents capable of performing specific tasks and multi-step workflows.
* Build automated workflows for information extraction, document analysis, reporting and business intelligence.
* Evaluate model performance, accuracy, cost and reliability.

**Business Process Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive and information-intensive business processes.
* Develop AI applications for email processing, document management, reporting, analysis and internal knowledge management.
* Integrate AI applications with Microsoft 365, Outlook and other company systems.
* Develop solutions that can process information from emails, Excel files, PDFs, Word documents and databases.

**Data and System Integration**

* Design and maintain databases required for AI applications.
* Develop APIs and integrations to connect AI applications with internal systems.
* Build mechanisms to retrieve, organise and process company information.
* Ensure appropriate data security, employee permissions and access controls.

**AI-Based Analysis and Intelligence**

* Develop applications for management reporting, business analysis and decision support.
* Explore predictive analytics and machine-learning applications for commercial and operational intelligence.
* Work with business teams to identify opportunities for improving efficiency and decision-making.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Test and evaluate AI applications for accuracy and reliability.
* Incorporate employee feedback and continuously improve workflows.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure applications are properly supported.
* Coordinate with external technology partners whenever specialist development or expertise is required.

##### **Qualification Requirements**

**Essential**

* Strong programming knowledge, preferably Python.
* Practical experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
* Experience building AI-powered applications and agents.
* Knowledge of API development and integrations.
* Experience with SQL databases and data management.
* Understanding of web application development and backend architecture.
* Knowledge of AI workflow automation and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft 365, Outlook and Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience with web technologies such as React, JavaScript or similar frameworks.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Experience with vector databases and document processing.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation, security and deployment.
* Exposure to machine learning and predictive analytics.

**Candidate Profile**

* Hands-on developer who has built and deployed actual AI applications.
* Able to take an idea from concept to a working application.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Comfortable interacting with business teams and understanding operational requirements.
* Willing to explore new AI technologies and continuously learn.
* Capable of working independently and taking ownership of projects.

##### **Remuneration**

* Salary Offered – As per Industry standards

##### **To Apply**

* Please send your CV in MS Word format by email to hr@bainbridgenav.com
* Please include your expected salary, last drawn salary, availability/notice period and reason for leaving past employment(s) in your resume.
* We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

To apply for this job **email your details** to hr@bainbridgenav.com

Noida

##### **Job Type**

Permanent

**About Us**
------------

At ScaleupAlly, we believe that technology improves all aspects of lives. That is why we are geared towards becoming a tech ally of great ideas. The aim is to be the remote in-house tech team of these ideas. We work with Start-ups, Founders, and Leaders around the globe with ideas of Web and App Development, Business Intelligence and Data Visualization. We achieve our aim by building the long-lasting dynamic teams made of the top talent across the globe managed by experienced in-house Technical Leads. At ScaleupAlly, we build, manage and care our distributed teams like no one else. It’s a whole new approach to make you rethink what your idea is capable of.

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **Purpose of Job**

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who is equally strong on the data side (modelling, data quality, SQL, understanding the business) and the engineering side (Python, PySpark, CI/CD, performance, reliability). You will own the design and delivery of production data platforms from requirements to production support, work directly with clients, and share your knowledge with the wider engineering team.

Your stack will include Python, SQL, PySpark, Azure Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse and Data Warehouse designs. **Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* Information Systems, or a related field.
* Holds at least 5-8 years in data engineering

**Skills** **ADF l Microsoft Fabric l SQL l ETL/ELT l Power BI | Python**

**Duties**

### 

* Own the design and delivery of data pipelines and platforms end to end: requirements, architecture, build, testing, deployment and production support.
* Design data models (dimensional, SCD, Medallion Bronze/Silver/Gold) that match how the business actually uses the data.
* Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark and Azure Data Factory on Azure Databricks or Microsoft Fabric.
* Implement batch, incremental/CDC and streaming loads, and tune Spark and SQL performance and cost.
* Build data quality checks, monitoring and alerting into every pipeline, and apply governance, lineage and access controls.
* Automate testing and deployment with Git and CI/CD, and follow engineering best practices in code reviews.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to gather requirements, explain design choices and agree acceptance criteria.
* Integrate data from APIs, transactional systems and external platforms.
* Investigate and resolve complex production issues and document root causes.
* Document your solutions and share knowledge with the team, including peer code reviews.

### 

  
  

### **Requirements**

Required Qualifications

* Data side: strong SQL, dimensional and Medallion/Lakehouse modelling, data quality practices, and the ability to understand business requirements.
* Engineering side: strong Python and PySpark, Git and CI/CD, automated testing, and performance tuning of high-volume workloads.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Data Factory or an equivalent orchestration tool.
* Proven delivery of batch and incremental/CDC pipelines on Delta Lake or similar.
* Client-facing experience: requirement gathering, stakeholder communication and clear technical documentation.
* Measurable impact you can explain, such as runtime, cost or data quality improvements.

Good to Have

* Streaming experience (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka).
* Governance and lineage tools (Unity Catalog, Azure Purview).
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform).
* Power BI and semantic-layer knowledge, to work effectively with BI teams.
* Microsoft certifications such as DP-203 or DP-600.

### **Benefits**

Benefits and Additional Information

* Working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* Working days: 5 days a week (plus 1st & 3rd Saturdays working)
* Medical Insurance coverage for employees
* Provident Fund (PF) facility
* Quarterly parties and yearly outings/trips for team bonding
* Regular check-ins with leadership for growth and feedback
* Recognition awards to celebrate high performance
* Fun activities and team engagement sessions throughout the year

title: Problem Manager
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About This Opportunity**

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.  
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.

**What You Will Do**  
  

* Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
* Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
* Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
* Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
* Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
* Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
* Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
* Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
* Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
* Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
* Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
* Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation
* Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
* Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
* Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
* Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs

**What You Will Bring**  
  

* Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
* Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
* Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
* Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes

**Experience & Qualifications**  

* 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
* Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
* Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
* Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM

**All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

In this role, Candidate is expected with an experience in core areas such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting, NAC (Network Access Control), and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the administration, upkeep, and upgrade of Cisco ISE solutions and deep understanding of network security concepts, Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols, endpoint profiling, posture assessments, BYOD, Guest, pxGrid, DNAC integration with ISE and network access control (NAC) technologies.

ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Advanced Application Packaging
  

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.

Deployment Integration Automation

Quality Governance

* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.

title: Sr. Test Engineer
description:
Job Description – Senior Software Tester

Job Title: Senior Software Tester / Senior QA Engineer  
Experience: 7–10+ years

Job location- NCR  
Job Type: Full-time  
Department: Quality Assurance / Software Testing

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Tester Senior Tester with hands-on testing expertise, client-facing responsibilities, and team management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, and automation framework development, along with the ability to coordinate testing activities across cross-functional teams.

The candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ownership of testing deliverables, and the ability to work effectively in an Agile environment while contributing to continuous improvement in QA processes.

2. Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Execution

* Analyse business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to identify test scenarios and testing scope.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Execute smoke, sanity, and release validation testing across different environments.
* Identify gaps in requirements and collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, and stakeholders to clarify expectations.
* Demonstrate strong client-handling skills, including regular communication with clients, understanding business expectations, providing testing updates, addressing concerns, and managing expectations effectively.
* Manage and coordinate the testing team, including task allocation, workload prioritisation, progress monitoring, review of testing deliverables, and ensuring timely completion of assigned activities.
* Proactively identify and communicate testing risks, dependencies, blockers, and potential delivery impacts to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, effectively prioritising testing activities, allocating time and resources, and meeting project milestones and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Ensure adequate test coverage and quality standards are maintained throughout the software development lifecycle.

Automation Testing

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using frameworks and tools such as Selenium, or Playwright.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation and contribute to automation strategy and framework improvements.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing.
* Analyse automation failures, troubleshoot issues, and distinguish between application defects, script failures, and environment-related issues.
* Maintain reusable automation components and ensure scripts remain reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve testing efficiency through automation and AI-assisted testing tools.

Defect Management

* Identify, document, prioritise, and track defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to investigate issues and validate fixes.
* Perform retesting and regression testing to ensure defects are resolved without introducing new issues.
* Provide clear defect reports with reproduction steps, test evidence, expected results, and actual results.
* Monitor defect trends and communicate quality risks, blockers, and dependencies proactively.

Team Coordination and Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate testing activities across team members, projects, and multiple applications.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, product owners, SMEs, and business users.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide regular updates on testing progress, execution status, defects, risks, and release readiness.
* Support UAT activities and coordinate with business users to validate business requirements.
* Mentor junior testers, review test cases and automation scripts, and share testing best practices.
* Take ownership of assigned testing deliverables and ensure timely completion of testing activities.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, test completion reports, and quality dashboards.
* Maintain testing artefacts and evidence in test management and project tracking tools.
* Identify process improvements to enhance test coverage, productivity, and release quality.
* Contribute to risk-based testing, test estimation, resource planning, and continuous QA improvement initiatives.
* Support production releases through smoke testing, sanity checks, and post-deployment validation.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Manual Testing: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Automation Testing: Hands-on experience Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent automation tools.
* Test Management: Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar test management and defect tracking tools.
* API Testing: Knowledge of REST APIs, request/response validation, and tools such as Postman.
* Database Testing: Ability to write SQL queries and validate backend data.
* CI/CD: Understanding of automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.
* Methodologies: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices.
* Documentation: Ability to create and maintain test plans, test cases, test reports, and traceability documentation.
* Version Control: Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control tools.

4. Required Experience and Competencies

* 7–10+ years of experience in software testing, including both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience testing enterprise web-based applications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and managing testing activities across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines effectively.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
* Experience mentoring team members and supporting knowledge transfer.

5. Desirable Skills

* Experience in telecom, asset management, waste management, hospitality, or other enterprise business domains.
* Exposure to mobile application testing on Android and iOS.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.
* Familiarity with cloud-based applications and enterprise integrations.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted testing, generative AI, AI agent validation, and intelligent test automation.
* Exposure to Business Analysis activities, including requirement reviews, process understanding, and acceptance criteria validation.

6. Key Success Criteria

The Senior Software Tester will be expected to:

* Deliver comprehensive test coverage aligned with business requirements.
* Identify critical defects early and minimise production issues.
* Maintain reliable and effective automation suites.
* Provide transparent and timely reporting on testing progress and quality risks.
* Coordinate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in testing practices and team capability.
* Support high-quality, predictable, and timely software releases.

Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI

The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.

You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.

**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.

* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.

* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.

description:

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI

**Role Overview**

The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.

As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.

You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.

**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
  

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentalsis desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**

  

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

**The Opportunity**

  

The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.

  

The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
